prompt: I'm thinking about building a Greek salary calculator — a free tool where people in Greece can enter their job title, years of experience, and city, and see what the market rate is for their salary. Greece has a very opaque salary market and people don't know if they're underpaid. I'd monetize through ads and maybe a premium 'get personalized salary report' feature. I have some data from job boards. Is this worth pursuing?

assertions.name: verdict_present
assertions.description: Output contains a verdict: one of BET, BUILD, PIVOT, or KILL

assertions.name: twelve_criteria_scored
assertions.description: Output shows all 12 scoring criteria with scores

assertions.name: scored_card_saved_to_vault
assertions.description: Scored card file exists at ideas/greek-salary-calculator/

assertions.name: competitor_section_present
assertions.description: Output includes a competitor landscape section

assertions.name: real_data_evidence
assertions.description: Evidence column contains specific numbers from CLI research (subscriber counts, Tranco ranks, domain ages)
